description: For page fixes, message match, buyer objections, copy rewrites or a client test brief. Finds an existing audit by page URL or client name and retrieves the selected skill plus its relevant evidence in one call. Returns source material for the requested deliverable, not a new AI analysis. Audit suggestions are not verified facts. Read-only: never starts an audit, uses a page or publishes. Missing evidence and ambiguous page matches are explicit.

audit_id.description: An audit ID returned by Postclick or extracted from the user’s /dashboard/a/<audit_id> link. For that link use audit_id, not page or latest. Never ask the user to find an ID.

context.description: The user's ad copy, audience, constraints or desired output. Pass known context; do not require an interview.

latest.description: Use true only when the user explicitly asks for their latest or most recent audit. May be combined with page to find its latest audit.

page.description: Page URL, domain or client name. Leave out when audit_id is known or the user explicitly requested latest.

section.description: For copy rewrites, defaults to opening (headline, supporting line and button). Use page when the user asks for other sections or the whole page.

skill.description: Choose postclick-fix-first for the first fix; postclick-copy-rewrite for replacement words; postclick-experiment-brief for a designer note or handoff; postclick-message-match for comparing an ad; postclick-buyer-objections for buyer hesitation.
